lounge.title: HOUSE INTERCOM — LOUNGE CONVERSATION VIEW
lounge.prompt: EXACT 564x278 native pixel art, ONE complete opaque RGB image (format opaque-complete, docs/92 section 1): no transparent foreground layer, no separate character sprite, no widened or scaled crop of the 314x206 scene. Subject: the SAME House of Tomorrow wall intercom as the integrated foyer and portrait-gallery conversation views (art/portraits/house/foyer_conversation.png, portrait_gallery_conversation.png): a flush wall-mounted 1960s ivory/cream rounded-rectangle panel, dark brown woven speaker grille, small black camera lens dot at the upper right, lower strip with a green indicator lamp at left and a ribbed horizontal thumbwheel at right, soft drop shadow on the wall. Mounted directly on the wall: NO post, stand or pedestal beneath it. Match those views' scale, placement, warm peach/cream wall palette, outlines and clean flat pixel clusters; restrained mid-century industrial retro-futurism; no brass, steampunk, gears, heavy dithering or blur. Camera: a tighter point-of-view into the corresponding main scene (art/scenes/house_of_tomorrow/lounge.png), with recognizable room cues at the frame edges only. No people, no hands, no protagonist, no text or UI baked in. LOUNGE cues from lounge.png: a sliver of the mint/teal Rest Assured recliner's padded headrest or armrest at one lower edge, a hint of the coral rug or warm wood cabinet, daylight tone from the garden window. The intercom remains the clear subject; the chair must not look occupied or threatening here.
